transient.instructions: Given the job metadata (repo, branch, runner, attempt number) and the last 200 log lines in `state`, decide whether the failure looks transient/environmental (network blip, runner resource exhaustion, package registry hiccup, flaky external service, timeout unrelated to test logic) as opposed to a deterministic failure caused by the code or test itself.

criteria.true: The logs point to infrastructure, network, timing, or environment causes that would plausibly not reproduce on a clean retry.
criteria.false: The logs point to a genuine code defect, failing assertion, compile error, or lint/type error that will reproduce identically on retry.

category.instructions: Classify the root cause of this CI job failure using the job metadata and last 200 log lines in `state`. Pick the single best-fitting category.

criteria.infra_transient: Runner, network, registry, or cloud provider issue (timeouts, connection resets, DNS failures, OOM-killed runner, disk full).
criteria.flaky_test: A specific test failed in a way consistent with known flakiness (race condition, timing assertion, order-dependent test, intermittent third-party test double).
criteria.code_defect: A test or build step failed due to an actual bug or incorrect code change (assertion mismatch tied to logic, compile/type error, lint failure).
criteria.dependency_or_config: Failure due to a missing/misconfigured dependency, environment variable, credential, or config value.
criteria.unknown: Logs are inconclusive or do not clearly indicate any of the above.

retrySuccessLikelihood.instructions: Considering the failure category, log contents, and the fact this is attempt {state.attempt} of {state.maxAttempts} on branch {state.branch}, estimate how likely an immediate retry of this exact job is to succeed.
